title: Version Golden Fixtures Explicitly
teaser: Old validation should not survive a changed reference dataset.
full_text: Record golden dataset version in evidence metadata and verify a fixture update invalidates prior proof automatically.

title: Do Not Leave Orphaned Notes After Profile Deletion
teaser: Domain relationships must survive destructive operations consistently.
full_text: Delete a profile with linked consultations and notes and verify the documented cascade or blocking policy is applied deterministically.

title: Record True or Mean Node Mode in the Manifest
teaser: A chart should not change silently because node settings changed.
full_text: Persist the selected lunar-node mode in the calculation manifest and verify the same input can be reproduced under that choice.

title: Expose Offline Search Coverage Clearly
teaser: An offline subset should not look like a complete global catalog.
full_text: Search for cities in airplane mode and verify the interface makes bundled dataset scope explicit.

title: Avoid Empty Section Headings in PDFs
teaser: A report should not contain headings with no meaningful body.
full_text: Render a selected section with no data and verify the renderer either omits it or prints the contracted empty-state explanation.

title: Measure Rewarded Unlocks with a Monotonic Clock
teaser: Changing wall time backward must not extend temporary access.
full_text: Start a temporary unlock then roll the device clock back and confirm expiry still follows the rollback-resistant time source.

title: Parse CSV Line Endings Consistently
teaser: Platform-specific newline styles must not change import results.
full_text: Feed equivalent LF and CRLF files through the same parser and verify they produce the same canonical rows.

title: Test Transit Orb Inclusion at the Exact Boundary
teaser: Floating-point noise should not randomly drop an aspect.
full_text: Evaluate fixtures just below at and just above the orb limit and verify the contracted inclusive or exclusive rule.

title: Normalize Unicode in Location Alias Search
teaser: Combining marks should not hide the same city from search.
full_text: Query NFC and NFD forms of the same city name and verify both resolve to one stable location identity.

title: Handle Draft State Explicitly After App Restart
teaser: Partial forms should neither vanish silently nor auto-commit.
full_text: Restart with an unfinished form and verify draft restoration follows the documented lifecycle policy.

title: Never Encode Status by Color Alone
teaser: Success warning and error states need nonvisual meaning.
full_text: Inspect status chips in the semantics tree and verify every color state has equivalent text or assistive meaning.

title: Tie Backup Manifest Versions to Migration Paths
teaser: New builds must not guess how to read older packages.
full_text: Restore the previous supported manifest version through the intended migration chain and reject unsupported versions explicitly.

title: Keep Numerology Letter Maps Independent from UI Locale
teaser: Changing language must not alter the selected calculation system.
full_text: Calculate the same name in Turkish and English interfaces and verify core values remain equal for the same numerology method.

title: Do Not Create Planetary Hours Without Solar Boundaries
teaser: Polar conditions must not be split into fake periods.
full_text: Use a fixture with unavailable sunrise or sunset and verify the provider returns the contracted unavailable state.

title: Keep Sensitive Names Out of PDF Metadata
teaser: Document properties should not expose unnecessary personal data.
full_text: Parse generated PDF metadata and verify profile names or internal identifiers are absent unless explicitly required.

title: Match Restore Preview with Applied Merge
teaser: The dry-run diff and final mutation summary should agree exactly.
full_text: Compare preview counts with the real merge result for the same package and verify they match record for record.

title: Derive Applying or Separating from Relative Motion
teaser: Aspect direction cannot be inferred from degree distance alone.
full_text: Use relative-motion fixtures and verify the computed applying or separating label matches expected dynamics.

title: Prevent Cycles in Localization Fallbacks
teaser: A broken fallback map must not recurse forever.
full_text: Run a fixture with mutual fallback references and verify the resolver detects the cycle and reaches a safe default.

title: Refresh the Current Screen After PRO Purchase
teaser: Users should not need to restart after entitlement changes.
full_text: Simulate a successful purchase from the paywall and verify gated content unlocks in the same session through state recomputation.

title: Use One Precision Rule for Chart Exports
teaser: UI and CSV rounding should not disagree.
full_text: Render one planetary longitude in UI PDF and CSV and verify each uses the same contracted precision.

title: Rebuild Search Index Only After Transaction Commit
teaser: A failed import must not publish a new index.
full_text: Inject a bulk-import error and verify index rebuild does not run before a successful database commit.

title: Protect PRO-Only Client Fields After Downgrade
teaser: Premium-created data should not become openly visible in Free mode.
full_text: Open a client record created under PRO while in Free state and verify protected fields are masked according to policy.

title: Record Timezone Dataset Version in Calculation Manifests
teaser: Tzdb updates can change results and need provenance.
full_text: Persist the tzdb version used for birth calculations and verify regression evidence contains the same provenance value.

title: Validate PDF Structure Beyond File Size
teaser: A large byte stream is not necessarily a valid document.
full_text: Build a fixture with a plausible header but broken cross-reference structure and verify structural validation rejects it.

title: Preserve Null and Empty String Separately in Restore
teaser: Migration must not collapse distinct data meanings.
full_text: Round-trip nullable note fields containing null and empty string and verify they remain distinct.

title: Route UI State with Stable Identifiers
teaser: Display-name edits must not break restored navigation.
full_text: Rename a saved record then restore an older route state and verify stable ID resolution opens the correct object.

title: Bind Content Catalog Hash to the Build Artifact
teaser: Runtime should prove which editorial catalog it contains.
full_text: Store the daily-message catalog hash in build metadata and verify it exactly matches the packaged asset hash.

title: Scan May Against Historical Exact Duplicates
teaser: New copy must not repeat an older catalog entry verbatim.
full_text: Compare May English title teaser and full_text fields against all previous English shards and reject any exact collision.

title: Check May Theme Distribution for Concentration
teaser: One technical topic should not dominate the daily catalog.
full_text: Count theme_tag frequencies and block ledger advancement when editorial concentration guardrails are exceeded.

title: Validate May as a Complete 31-Day Set
teaser: Missing final rows must not pass through a loose counter.
full_text: Generate the canonical May 2035 civil-date set and compare it exactly with both locale shards independently.

title: Close May Coverage from Main Only
teaser: Local drafts are not reviewed coverage.
full_text: Reload both May shards from main verify 31 canonical rows per locale and record 2035-06-01 as the next exact start.
